portal.vendor_source: portal fingerprint: a LocalGov Drupal 10 view on the council's own site (Generator meta tag), with documents linked directly from a public S3 bucket. No vendor signature in vendors.json matches.

committee_papers.note: Committee id confirmed by the Modern.gov web service (GetCommittees) on 2026-09-26. The same install carries expired committees of the former Carlisle, Copeland and Cumbria County councils. No committee document downloaded.

reference_format.note: The format depends on the legacy area. Copeland area (this register): 4/YY/NNNN/<code>, e.g. 4/26/2279/0F1 or 4/26/2293/DOC. The Carlisle and Allerdale areas use their own registers and formats.

browser_route.note: The area-picker page. From there the user chooses Allerdale, Carlisle or Copeland.

quirks.summary: Cumberland has no single register: planning applications are still filed by legacy district area, each on a different system.
quirks.detail: The council's 'Search planning applications' page (checked 2026-09-26) asks the user to pick an area: Allerdale -> the Arcus register at cumberlandcouncil.my.site.com/pr3 (see allerdale-borough-council); Carlisle -> the Idox portal at publicaccess.carlisle.gov.uk (see carlisle-city-council); Copeland -> this register on www.cumberland.gov.uk. Minerals and waste applications have a separate page. Only the Copeland-area register was tested here.
quirks.workaround: Route by the reference: 4/YY/... references are Copeland-area and live here; take Carlisle-area references to the Carlisle Idox profile and Allerdale-area references to the Allerdale (Arcus, browser-only) profile. A search here for a non-Copeland reference finds nothing, which is not evidence it does not exist.

quirks.summary: The detail page URL is /planning/application/<reference with slashes removed, lower-cased>, e.g. 4/26/2279/0F1 -> /planning/application/42622790f1.
quirks.detail: Observed across the 25 rows on the register's first page and confirmed on one detail page. Not guaranteed for every case.
quirks.workaround: Try the constructed URL first; if it 404s, search the register by reference (the 'title' filter).

quirks.summary: Documents are served from a public S3 bucket under their upload file names, which can be reused and can name the wrong document; the link text is the reliable label.
quirks.detail: On 4/26/2279/0F1 the row labelled 'Consultee Response - United Utilities 21-09-2026' links to 'Consultee Response - Natural England 21-09-2026_0.pdf'; the file is the United Utilities response. Names carry _0, _1, _6 suffixes where the same name was uploaded before, because every application shares one planning/ prefix in the bucket.
quirks.workaround: Label files from the link text, not the S3 file name, and never de-duplicate or name output by the S3 file name alone.

pacing.note: Nine requests to www.cumberland.gov.uk and one to the S3 bucket on 2026-09-26, at 5 s or more, with no 429 or challenge. The site is behind Cloudflare (passive at the time). robots.txt sets Crawl-delay: 6, so pace at 6 s.

robots.note: www.cumberland.gov.uk/robots.txt is the standard Drupal file: it disallows admin, user and /search paths, not /planning/, and sets Crawl-delay: 6. The S3 bucket's robots.txt was not checked.

endpoints.note: No session, cookie or token needed. Document links are absolute S3 URLs with raw spaces; percent-encode them.

verification.note: PlanIt has no Cumberland planning area. The council site's search page routes by legacy area (Allerdale -> Arcus, Carlisle -> Idox, Copeland -> a register on the council's own Drupal site). Copeland-area register tested: application-search listing -> 4/26/2279/0F1 detail page with 13 document rows and 13 S3 links -> downloaded the row labelled United Utilities: application/pdf, %PDF-1.7, 1,306,263 bytes, 6 pages with extractable text naming United Utilities, no rate-limit, permission or unavailable notice. Allerdale and Carlisle routes not tested here. Modern.gov GetCommittees checked for the committee id.
